item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Store scope explicitly for every claim","mechanism":"Structured scope prevents similar wording from merging findings about different populations, conditions, outcomes, or periods.","implementation":"Require exact stored passage IDs; capture population, condition, outcome, and period from those passages. Mark unspecified scope as unknown.","check":"Enter similar claims with opposing findings in adults and adolescents; verify separate records preserve their populations and passage IDs.","risk":"Inferred scope could introduce information absent from supplied passages."},{"action":"Separate opposition from absent evidence","mechanism":"Explicit evidence relationships distinguish supporting passages, opposing passages, differently scoped findings, and unassessed relationships.","implementation":"Attach relationship labels to claim–passage links. Represent missing evidence as an empty state, never as an opposing passage.","check":"Remove all supporting links from a draft claim; verify it becomes unsubstantiated, not refuted, and cannot enter the briefing.","risk":"Relationship labels require review when passages contain qualifications or ambiguity."},{"action":"Show disagreement before polished summaries","mechanism":"A comparison view exposes opposing findings while separating direct contradictions from differences in scope.","implementation":"Display related claims side by side with scope fields, finding direction, and exact passage IDs; mark unknown scope as unresolved.","check":"Opposing findings for different populations display as scope differences; opposing findings with matching recorded scope display as potential contradictions.","risk":"Matching recorded scope does not establish that studies are fully comparable."},{"action":"Build briefing statements from scoped evidence","mechanism":"Statement-level provenance makes each assertion inspectable and prevents citations from concealing unsupported generalization.","implementation":"Generate only from selected stored passages. Require each statement to retain scope qualifiers and exact passage IDs; split independently supported assertions.","check":"Select adult-only evidence; reject an unqualified all-populations statement. Verify each exported assertion retains its supporting passage IDs.","risk":"Citation presence alone cannot establish that a passage supports the wording."},{"action":"Inspect original passages beside briefing text","mechanism":"An in-workspace evidence drawer lets users compare original wording with the claim without losing drafting context.","implementation":"Make every passage ID open its immutable stored text, report label, and available location metadata beside the selected statement.","check":"Open citations from a claim, comparison view, and briefing; verify each shows the exact stored passage without navigating away.","risk":"Unavailable surrounding report text must not be fabricated as context."},{"action":"Allocate short briefing space to disagreement","mechanism":"A coverage gate prevents brevity from silently dropping opposing evidence relevant to included claims.","implementation":"Before export, flag linked opposing or differently scoped findings omitted from each statement; offer paired wording or removal of the statement.","check":"Under a two-sentence limit, include opposing adult and adolescent findings; verify both populations remain named rather than collapsed into consensus.","risk":"Coverage checks cannot detect relevant evidence that has not been linked."},{"action":"Invalidate briefings when evidence changes","mechanism":"Dependency tracking exposes statements whose passages, scope, or evidence relationships changed after drafting.","implementation":"Version passages immutably. Store each statement’s passage IDs and dependency versions; mark affected statements stale and require review before export.","check":"Revise a linked claim’s population or opposition label; verify its briefing statement becomes stale while unrelated statements remain unchanged.","risk":"Frequent edits may create excessive review work unless invalidation stays targeted."},{"action":"Distinguish repeated evidence from independent findings","mechanism":"Provenance grouping prevents repeated supplied passages from appearing to constitute multiple independent confirmations.","implementation":"Allow users to group passages describing the same underlying finding when supplied text establishes that relationship; preserve every exact passage ID.","check":"Add the same finding from two supplied reports; verify grouping preserves both citations without labeling them independent confirmations or resolving opposition.","risk":"Do not infer shared provenance merely from similar wording."}],"abstention_reason":""}
